build_hand_mvp_autoencoder: build a hand MVP autoencoder model with pose encoder, geometry decoder, and RGB decoder for neural rendering
run_autoencoder_forward: run the AutoEncoder forward pass with pose and camera parameters to predict hand rendering primitives
render_hand_primitives: render hand RGBA primitives using ray marching with camera intrinsics and extrinsics matrices
create_geometry_decoder: create a geometry decoder that predicts primitive positions, rotations, scales, and alpha from pose embeddings
summarize_hand_mvp_summary: summarize hand MVP predictions by computing RGB slabs, alpha slabs, and rendering diagnostics for visualization
